title: Cortesia professionale
summary: Build a compact set of polite forms for requests, thanks and clarification in ordinary professional conversation.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

items: Grazie mille. — Thank you very much.
Non ho capito bene. — I did not understand clearly.
Va bene, grazie. — That is fine, thank you.

blocks.text: Italian changes according to familiarity and formality. This preview introduces both informal and formal forms, but a real curriculum should define the preferred register for specific MOSCATELLI situations.
